title: Sri Lanka Official CPG Brand Scraper Input

domains.title: Filter Domains (optional)
domains.description: Optional list of specific domains to crawl (e.g. ['ustore.lk', 'elephanthouse.lk']). Leave empty to crawl all 47 official Sri Lankan brand & supermarket domains plus auto-discovered brands.

includeSupermarkets.title: Include Online Supermarkets
includeSupermarkets.description: Whether to also crawl Sri Lankan online supermarkets (Keells, Cargills Online, Glomark) alongside official brand sites.

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Max Pages Per Domain
maxPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum pages to intelligently traverse per brand website.

maxProductsPerDomain.title: Max Products Per Domain
maxProductsPerDomain.description: Maximum products to extract per brand website.

enableAutonomousDiscovery.title: Enable Autonomous Sri Lanka Brand & Product Discovery
enableAutonomousDiscovery.description: Autonomously discovers missing Sri Lankan CPG brands and new products on the internet (Open Food Facts SL, supermarket brand mining, DuckDuckGo/Serper search, and optional Gemini AI), validates their official domains, and persists them for future runs.

enableOpenFoodFacts.title: Include Open Food Facts (Sri Lanka)
enableOpenFoodFacts.description: Query the free Open Food Facts Sri Lanka API to discover new CPG products and missing Sri Lankan brands.

maxOpenFoodFactsPages.title: Max Open Food Facts Pages
maxOpenFoodFactsPages.description: Number of 100-item pages to fetch from Open Food Facts Sri Lanka (sorted by most recently modified).

maxNewBrandsPerRun.title: Max New Brand Domains Per Run
maxNewBrandsPerRun.description: Maximum newly discovered Sri Lankan CPG brand websites to validate and crawl per run.

discoveryStateStoreName.title: Persistent Discovery State KV Store Name
discoveryStateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist seen product slugs (for isNew/firstSeenAt tracking) and newly discovered Sri Lankan brand domains across runs.

serperApiKey.title: Serper.dev Google Search API Key (optional)
serperApiKey.description: Optional Serper API key for Sri Lanka Google Search (gl=lk) brand discovery. If omitted, falls back to zero-API-key DuckDuckGo search.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API Key (optional)
geminiApiKey.description: Optional Google Gemini API key to use Gemini 2.5 Flash with Google Search grounding for discovering missing Sri Lankan CPG brands.

agrodropSyncUrl.title: AgroDrop Sync Webhook URL (optional)
agrodropSyncUrl.description: e.g. https://your-agrodrop-domain.vercel.app/api/cpg/sync — if set, pushes scraped products directly into AgroDrop's Supabase Product DB.

agrodropSyncSecret.title: AgroDrop Sync Secret (optional)
agrodropSyncSecret.description: Matches CPG_SYNC_SECRET in AgroDrop environment variables.
